address: Rua Conde de Bernadotte, 26 - loja 101, Rio de Janeiro, 22430-200, Brazil
bio: Everything people are talking about is Madame Olympe, the restaurant located in the Terrasse Center shopping complex, in the elegant neighbourhood of Leblon. There, the duo of Claude Troisgros and Jéssica Trindade presents a fine-dining concept that celebrates French savoir-faire — most notably in the breads and their exquisitely delicate sauces — while championing Brazilian ingredients and weaving in subtle nods to the world of Japanese gastronomy. In this contemporary space, where original rice-paper lamps evoke floating clouds, everything revolves around an eight-course tasting menu or a shorter four-course option, in which guests choose the dishes they wish to try (don't miss the duck magret with heart of palm, sea purslane, tucupi — a tangy broth extracted from wild manioc — and cauliflower). The celebrated French chef, after more than 45 years living in the land of the Canarinha — as Brazil is affectionately known — confesses to being utterly captivated by its produce, much of it sourced from small local farmers, making the experience all the more singular.
